# reco_roles (Data Source)

Lists all RBAC roles (custom and system).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "reco_roles" "all" {}

output "custom_role_names" {
  value = [for r in data.reco_roles.all.roles : r.name if r.type == "USER_ROLE_TYPE_CUSTOM"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `roles` (Attributes List) List of roles. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Role description.
- `name` (String) Role name.
- `permissions` (List of String) Permissions granted by this role.
- `resources` (Attributes List) Fine-grained resource-level permissions attached to this role. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles--resources))
- `type` (String) Role type (CUSTOM, SYSTEM, etc.).

### Nested Schema for `roles.resources`

Read-Only:
